title: Clothes
descriptionFa: اسم لباس‌ها و وسایل همراه، کلمه‌هایی که همیشه جمع‌اند، و فعل‌های پوشیدن و درآوردن.

words.example: My grandfather never goes out without his hat.
She wore a blue silk scarf.
It's snowing, so wear your warm coat.
Take a jacket. It might get cold tonight.
My mother knitted this jumper for me.
words.tipFa: بریتانیایی‌ها به پلیور هم jumper می‌گن هم sweater. ولی در آمریکا پلیور فقط sweater هست و jumper یعنی «سارافون» (پیراهن بی‌آستین روی بلوز).

words.example: He ironed his white shirt for the interview.
I usually wear a T-shirt and jeans at the weekend.
Maryam bought a long red dress for the party.
Her school uniform has a grey skirt.
The groom wore a dark blue suit.
Can you help me with my tie?
These trousers are too big. I need a belt.
I can't find my other socks!
words.tipFa: مفردش sock هست، ولی معمولاً جمع می‌گیم: a pair of socks.

words.example: Please take off your shoes at the door.
I need new trainers for the gym.
Wear your boots. There is snow on the ground.
My hands are cold. Where are my gloves?
He gave her a gold ring.
My watch is five minutes fast.
These trousers are too long for me.
words.tipFa: همیشه جمعه و فعل جمع می‌گیره: My trousers are old. یه دونه‌ش می‌شه a pair of trousers.

words.example: Her jeans are new.
words.tipFa: همیشه جمع: a pair of jeans.

words.example: It's hot today, so the children are wearing shorts.
She wore black tights under her skirt.
The kids are already in their pyjamas.
I can't read the menu without my glasses.
words.tipFa: همیشه جمع: My glasses are on the table. a pair of glasses.

words.example: Don't forget your sunglasses. It's very sunny.
She keeps her keys in her handbag.
Take an umbrella. It's going to rain.
My suitcase is too heavy to carry.
Do you have to wear a uniform at work?
words.tipFa: لباس، عینک، ساعت و انگشتر رو wear می‌کنیم. گذشته: wore.

words.example: Can you carry this bag for me?
words.tipFa: لباس رو wear می‌کنیم، ولی کیف و چتر و چمدون رو carry.

words.example: Hurry up and get dressed. We're late!
The children get undressed and go to bed at nine.
Put on your coat. It's cold outside.
words.tipFa: می‌شه گفت put your coat on هم. ضدش take off هست، نه put off.

words.example: Please take off your shoes before you come in.

gapQuestions.sentence: I'm flying to Mashhad tomorrow, so tonight I'm packing my ___.
gapQuestions.hintFa: برای سفر وسایل رو توش می‌ذاریم.
